ai_summary: This document from Arman Financial Services Limited announces the 34th Annual General Meeting and the availability of the FY2025-26 Annual Report. Crucially, it mandates shareholders to update their PAN, KYC details, and nominations for physical securities as per recent SEBI regulations, providing links and contact information for compliance. A key takeaway is the significant issue of unclaimed dividends, with amounts for FY2017-18 and earlier already transferred to the IEPF, prompting shareholders to claim the remaining FY2018-19 dividend promptly.
